# API for Workflow Management

Covers dimension 7 (API for workflow management). All citations reference
entries in [citations.md](../citations.md).

---

## API Overview

Tines provides a REST API at `https://<tenant-domain>/api/v1/<endpoint>` [17].

### Authentication

Two methods [17]:
- `X-User-Token` header
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header

### Pagination

| Parameter | Default | Maximum | Source |
|-----------|---------|---------|--------|
| `per_page` | 20 | 500 | [17] |

Response includes a `meta` object with: current page link, previous/next
links, per_page value, total pages, item count [17].

### Rate Limits

| Endpoint | Requests/Min | Source |
|----------|-------------|--------|
| Most APIs | 5,000 | [18] |
| actions | 100 | [18] |
| admin/users | 500 | [18] |
| audit_logs | 1,000 | [18] |
| records | 400 | [18] |
| tokens (auth) | 2,500 | [18] |

Enforced per IP address + API token combination [18].

## Endpoint Categories

The API covers [17]:

| Category | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Stories | Create, read, list, export, import workflows |
| Actions | Manage actions within stories |
| Credentials | CRUD for all credential types |
| Cases | Case management with fields, files, tasks, comments |
| Records | Structured data management |
| Teams | Team management |
| Users | User administration |
| Folders | Organization |
| Resources | Shared resources |
| Audit Logs | Activity tracking |
| Admin | Egress control, IP access, certificates, jobs |
| Dashboards | Analytics |
| Reporting | Reports |
| Workbench | AI chat interface |
| SCIM | Identity provider integration |

## Story Management via API

### CRUD Operations

| Operation | Endpoint | Source |
|-----------|----------|--------|
| Create | POST `/api/v1/stories/` | [17] |
| Read | GET `/api/v1/stories/<story_id>` | [17] |
| List | GET `/api/v1/stories/` | [17] |
| Export | GET `/api/v1/stories/<story_id>/export` | [17] |
| Import | POST `/api/v1/stories/import` | [17] |

Create requires: name, description, team_id, folder_id [discovery findings].
Import accepts: story data, new_name, team_id, folder_id [discovery findings].

**Note:** Update and delete story endpoints were not explicitly found in
the fetched documentation, though the API covers full CRUD for stories [17].
Story version APIs were found in discovery, suggesting version control
capabilities.

### Triggering Workflows

Workflows are triggered via webhook actions [34]:
- HTTP request to webhook URL initiates story run
- 30-second timeout for Exit Action to produce response [34]
- X-Tines-Status header indicates status [34]
- X-Tines-Response-Location provides async result URL [34]

### Querying Execution Status

| Endpoint | Purpose | Source |
|----------|---------|--------|
| `/api/v1/stories/<id>/runs/<guid>` | List events for a run | [20] |
| `/api/v1/actions/<id>/logs` | Action execution history | [discovery findings] |
| `/api/v1/audit_logs` | Audit log access | [17] |

Story runs have unique GUIDs for identification [20].

## Gaps and Limitations

- **Update/Delete story endpoints undocumented** — not found in fetched
  content, though likely exist given the API covers "full CRUD" [17]
- **Actions endpoint rate limit is low** — only 100 req/min for actions
  vs 5,000 for most endpoints [18]
- **Records endpoint rate limit is low** — only 400 req/min [18]
- **Pagination max 500 items** — may require multiple requests for large
  datasets [17]
